characteristic_sites: spleen involvement more common than in NS

biomarkers.name: CD30, CD15, CD20 (typical cHL panel)
biomarkers.prevalence: CD30 positive in nearly all cases; CD15 positive in ~75-85%; CD20 variably positive in a minority of cases
biomarkers.clinical_use: Diagnostic immunophenotype for cHL; CD30 is a therapeutic target in cHL

biomarkers.name: EBV (EBER ISH)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Higher than NS; associates with HIV and low-resource settings

biomarkers.name: PD-L1
biomarkers.prevalence: High expression is common in HRS cells; 9p24.1/PD-L1/PD-L2 alterations are frequent in cHL

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Reed-Sternberg cells and Hodgkin cells scattered in mixed inflammatory infiltrate without prominent fibrous banding

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Mixed inflammatory infiltrate (T cells, histiocytes, eosinophils, plasma cells); EBV-driven immune interactions in ~70%
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Diffuse or interfollicular growth without dense fibrous banding

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Same crippled germinal centre B cells as other cHL subtypes; EBV-positive in ~70% of mixed cellularity (higher than NS)
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Same RS cell biology as NS-cHL; distinctive TME with mixed inflammatory infiltrate (T cells, histiocytes, eosinophils, plasma cells) without prominent fibrous banding
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Same lineage principles as NS-cHL; EBV-driven cases show LMP1 expression which activates NF-κB signalling — provides alternative pro-survival mechanism to somatic mutations
